# Waylo

> Waylo is AI chat for B2B and SaaS websites. It learns a company's public web pages and answers visitor questions with a link to the page behind each answer. It flags buying intent and can send warm leads to the team in Slack or a CRM. It installs with one script tag.

Site: https://waylo-j5hv.onrender.com · Help and support: https://waylo-j5hv.onrender.com/contact · Status: early access, self-serve

## Key facts
- Answers come from crawled public pages (sitemap first, plus linked PDF and .docx files) and facts the customer adds. Every answer cites sources.
- When content doesn't cover a question, Waylo says so and offers the contact form.
- Buying-intent signals: pricing, integration, security, and demo interest.
- Integrations (Starter and up): Slack incoming webhook and a JSON outbound webhook. Route it to HubSpot, Salesforce, and others with Zapier, Make, or your own endpoint. No native CRM apps.
- Install: `<script src="https://waylo-j5hv.onrender.com/waylo.js" data-site="YOUR_SITE" async></script>` before </body>. Works with Webflow, WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace, Wix, Google Tag Manager.
- Embed modes: launcher (default), sidebar, track (analytics only).
- Pricing: Trial $0 (1 site, 500 AI messages, 100 pages); Starter $79/mo (3,000 messages a month, 500 pages, Slack and webhooks); Growth $249/mo (3 sites, 15,000 messages a month, 2,000 pages, Audiences). No overage fees. At the limit the chat pauses and shows the contact form.
- AI model: OpenAI API (gpt-4o-mini by default).
- Public /demo (https://waylo-j5hv.onrender.com/demo) is a fictional field-service company, Northpoint Ops. Its chat answers from that site’s pages.
- Hosting and processors: Postgres on Supabase, app hosted on Render, replies written by OpenAI.
- Not available today: SSO/SAML, SOC 2 report, DPA, native CRM apps, live agent chat, white-label, agency pricing, JavaScript-rendered pages, scanned PDFs.
